summary: Greenland Mines Ltd (GRML) filed an 8-K on May 20, 2026, announcing entry into a merger agreement to acquire Neo North Star Resources, Inc. through its wholly owned subsidiary, Greenland Rare Earths Corp. Total consideration is $35 million, comprising $20 million in cash and $15 million in newly issued GRML common stock, valued at a 20-day VWAP. The deal is subject to customary closing conditions and requires approval from the government of Greenland under section 69 of the Greenland Mineral Activities Act regarding transfer of mineral rights. No board recommendation or advisors are named. Watch for regulatory timeline from Greenland and potential risk on share price volatility due to stock consideration.
